mostWorthwhile.text: Building the nutrient cycle from fungal decomposition through soil to renewed forest made the roles of decomposers and roots clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The three initial inspections returned no partners, making the starting point frustratingly unclear.

surprise.text: The forest could contribute water vapour to clouds and rainfall through transpiration, revealing another connection after nutrient renewal.

arbitrary.text: The opening route through rainfall and air was a guess after several empty inspections; its purpose became clear only when it produced a storm.
